model_info.description: Default brain: cheap cloud (DeepSeek V4 Flash), every turn. Re-picked 2026-05-22 from gpt-5-mini (dominated on price/AA-II/tau2). 1M context. $50 of the EUR100 split.
On-device local (Mac M2 Max): privacy / EUR0 / bulk; slow, uncapped, always available. num_ctx 65536 = Hermes main-model floor. Also the main->budget-cap fallback target.
Hermes text aux tasks: local 4B on the Arch 7900XTX (on-device, EUR0, logged but never counts against the cap).
Heavy research: Gemini 3.1 Pro (promoted from fallback 2026-05-22; old gpt-5 deep was dominated). 1M context. $35 of the EUR100 split.
Used only if deep (Gemini) errors/outage. GPT-5: weaker but first-party-served (OpenAI+Azure) = high availability for outage insurance. $15 of the EUR100 split.
